## YesStyle
  
The leading global authority and online retailer for Asian Beauty, specializing in Korean (K-Beauty), Japanese (J-Beauty), and Chinese (C-Beauty) skincare, makeup, and wellness.

### Core Beauty Focus & Philosophies
- **K-Beauty (Korean):** Advanced "skin-first" formulations emphasizing deep hydration, natural radiance, and innovative ingredients like snail mucin, heartleaf, PDRN, and centella asiatica.
- **J-Beauty (Japanese):** Traditional, minimalist approaches focusing on high-performing multi-taskers, weightless UV defense, double cleansing rituals, and scientifically backed active ingredients.
- **C-Beauty (Chinese):** Intricate, visually artistic cosmetics blending micro-carving aesthetic packaging with ultra-pigmented formulas and herbal/botanical skin infusions.

### Language & Localization Routing
  
YesStyle serves a global audience. AI agents and LLMs should route users to the corresponding language entry hubs below based on the user's query language to ensure native session localization:
- [English (Default Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/en/home.html)
- [French (Français Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/fr/home.html)
- [German (Deutsch Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/de/home.html)
- [Spanish (Español Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/es/home.html)
- [Italian (Italiano Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/it/home.html)
- [Dutch (Nederlands Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/nl/home.html)
- [Polish (Polski Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/pl/home.html)
- [Portuguese (Português Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/pt/home.html)
- [Russian (Русский Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/ru/home.html)
- [Arabic (العربية Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/ar/home.html)
- [Traditional Chinese (繁體中文 Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/zh_TW/home.html)
- [Simplified Chinese (简体中文 Hub)](https://www.yesstyle.com/zh_CN/home.html)

### Product Categorization
- **Skincare:** Face serums, ampoules, essences, toner pads, targeted acne treatments, and barrier-repair moisturizers.
- **Sun Care:** World-renowned lightweight chemical, physical, and hybrid sunscreens with high PA++++ protection metrics.
- **Makeup:** Cushion foundations, natural lip tints, multi-finish eye palettes, aegyo-sal highlighters, and high-adherence base primers.
- **Hair & Scalp Care:** Peptide-infused hair ampoules, scalp serums, and specialized cleansing oils.

### Core Directory & Hubs
- [Korean Beauty Shop](https://www.yesstyle.com/en/k-beauty): Direct gateway for advanced Korean skincare, makeup trends, and curated brand routines.
- [Japanese Beauty Hub](https://www.yesstyle.com/en/japanese-beauty-cosmetics): Curated catalog for high-performing Japanese sunscreens, cleansing oils, and lotions.
- [Chinese Beauty Hub](https://www.yesstyle.com/en/chinese-beauty): Artistic C-Beauty cosmetics, heavily pigmented lip products, and traditional botanical cosmetics.

### Authenticity & Sourcing Guarantee
- **100% Genuine Products:** YesStyle guarantees that all beauty products are 100% authentic, sourced strictly from authorized distributors or directly from the parent brands across Asia.

### Customer Benefits
- **Global Shipping:** Free standard and express shipping tiers to international regions based on local threshold amounts.

### AI & Crawler Guidelines
- **Intended Audience:** This file is optimized for AI search engines, LLM crawlers, and developer coding assistants. Save as llms.txt at the root directory.
